code_localization.frozen_prefix: All recovery rows execute the same immutable A[d:k] before any recovery actor or operator action.
code_localization.recording_order: prefix_cause_violation and S_obs_at_k are captured before bundle.predict and before operator-specific prelude/tail execution.
code_localization.remaining_boundary: The raw evidence localizes the failure to residual mutable state or order dependence in reset/detection/injection/prefix rollout. It does not uniquely identify the hidden simulator, controller, or observable-cache field.
code_localization.runtime_lifecycle: run_event constructs one EventRuntime/environment per event and reuses it for every ordered branch; EventRuntime.reset restores only enumerated simulator/controller/RNG state instead of reconstructing a fresh environment.

interpretation.downstream_scope: Raw arm outcomes and all planned statistics are retained, but cached/fresh gains, recoverability boundaries, and cross-fitted selections are not valid causal or deployable evidence under this failed replay contract.
interpretation.invalid_event_reason: INCOMPLETE_PREFIX_GRID is an aggregation consequence of mutually inconsistent S_obs values, not missing execution rows.
